item.title: Bombay High Court bars salon’s continued use of ‘Jawed Habib’ trademarks and copyrights following expiry of franchise agreement; Issues ad-interim injunction
item.description: “The franchise agreement prima facie indicated acceptance of ownership of the plaintiff in the registered trademarks and permitted use only during subsistence of the agreement.” The post Bombay High Court bars salon’s continued use of ‘Jawed Habib’ trademarks and copyrights following expiry of franchise agreement; Issues ad-interim injunction appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Making minor touch private parts with sexual intent constitutes Aggravated Sexual Assault under POCSO Act: Delhi High Court
item.description: Minor inconsistencies arising from age, vocabulary or manner of narration do not erode the credibility of the prosecution, particularly where the allegation relates to commission of sexual assault with sexual intent. The post Making minor touch private parts with sexual intent constitutes Aggravated Sexual Assault under POCSO Act: Delhi High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madras HC directs immediate police action over derogatory book title targeting sitting Judge; initiates suo motu criminal contempt against publisher
item.description: “The pictorial representation, the caricature and the expressions/words used are not only highly derogatory, but virtually abusive.” The post Madras HC directs immediate police action over derogatory book title targeting sitting Judge; initiates suo motu criminal contempt against publisher appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Kerala HC calls out delay in enacting Anti-Superstition Law, Directs State to consider Special Cell as interim measure to address complaints
item.description: “The Court noted the relevance of Article 51-A(h), which enjoins citizens to develop a scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry, and the petitioner’s reliance on Article 21 of the Constitution, and that despite repeated adjournments and assurances, the State had neither enacted legislation nor conclusively declined to do so over a span of nearly four years.” The post Kerala HC calls out delay in enacting Anti-Superstition Law, Directs State to consider Special Cell as interim measu

item.title: Masterclass on GST | Tarun Jain on Constitutional Reform, Supreme Court Jurisprudence & GST Council
item.description: In this episode of Masterclass by EBC Authors, Advocate Tarun Jain, Supreme Court of India unpacks GST not merely as a tax reform but as a constitutional re-engineering of India’s federal structure. From the 101st Constitutional Amendment to Supreme Court rulings and the institutional design of the GST Council, this masterclass explores how GST has transformed legislative power, Centre–State relations, and cooperative federalism. item.title: Prolonged incarceration cannot entitle allowance of successive bail: Punjab and Haryana High Court denied bail in SFIO investigation case
item.description: “A second/successive regular bail application cannot be rejected solely on the ground of maintainability thereof, but for such petition to succeed, the petitioner is required to show some substantial change in circumstances.” The post Prolonged incarceration cannot entitle allowance of successive bail: Punjab and Haryana High Court denied bail in SFIO investigation case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised J.P. Morgan Services India Private Limited on setting up of Asia’s largest GCC
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised J.P. Morgan Services India Private Limited on setting up Asia’s largest Global Capability Centre through a landmark lease of approximately 1.3 million sq. ft. of built-to-suit office space in Powai, Mumbai. The transaction marks the largest single-user office leasing deal in India to date. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised J.P. item.title: SEBI Introduces Digital Signature Certificate Integration for Seamless FPI Onboarding
item.description: SEBI has introduced a new Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) feature in the Common Application Form (CAF) portal, allowing Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) to complete registration and DSC application in one seamless process. This enhancement simplifies onboarding and promotes greater use of digital functionality. The post SEBI Introduces Digital Signature Certificate Integration for Seamless FPI Onboarding appeared first on SCC Times.
